messages:
Mia: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of inbound leads stuck in "enrichment pending" for >2h, then not hitting SDRs. Example: lead 45123 (email+company) bounced off round-robin and landed in no-owner. Anyone else seeing this?
Noah: saw a spike earlier, thought it was a transient API error with Clearbit. Logged an incident but didn’t correlate to routing.
Mia: I pulled a report — ~42 leads in last 24h. SLA alert didn’t fire because ownership timestamp never set.
Sasha: Oof. That explains why follow-up rates dipped. Can you paste the workflow condition?
Mia: Here — HubSpot workflow snippet (current):
```
If: Contact.property "enrichment_status" == "complete"
Then: Enroll in workflow -> Assign owner via round_robin(Active_SDRs)
Else: wait 1 hour -> re-enroll
```
Mia: Problem: enrichment sometimes returns "manual_review" or blank for partners without Clearbit profile, so contacts never hit the Assign step.
Arjun: Quick fix idea: create a fallback queue for any contact where enrichment_status != "complete" after 30 mins. That queue owned by "Inbound Review" (marketing ops) and will set owner to a placeholder SDR group so SLA clock starts.
Noah: Agree. Also we should change the round-robin to skip reps who haven't logged in for >7 days or have "out_of_office" tag. Current round-robin is naive.
Sasha: I can add checks in Salesforce assignment rules too — e.g., skip user if User.is_active == false or LastLogin < now - 7d. For HubSpot we can add property checks.
Jules: Can we add an ownership timestamp field that gets set when either assigned to a rep OR placed in fallback queue? This will trigger the 30m SLA ping.
Mia: Proposed workflow updates:
1) Immediately: modify HubSpot workflow to -> after 30m of enrollment if enrichment_status != "complete" then assign to Inbound Review queue + set property "ownership_assigned_ts" = {{timestamp}}.
2) Change round_robin function to consult property "sdr_available" (boolean) and LastActivity > -7d. If none available, fall back to Inbound Review.
3) Add a daily job to retroactively surface leads with ownership_assigned_ts null and created_at > 24h into a report.
Noah: Who owns making the HubSpot change? I can do the workflow edit but need salesops signoff for the fallback group mapping.
Sasha: SalesOps will own the round-robin logic + SF rules. I’ll draft SQL-ish pseudocode for the selection:
```
SELECT user_id FROM sdrs
WHERE is_active = true
AND last_login >= now() - interval '7 days'
AND tags NOT IN ('ooo','on_leave')
ORDER BY last_assigned_at ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
Sasha: If that returns zero rows, return fallback_pool_id.
Arjun: Also suggest we patch the enrichment integration to write "n/a" not blank when no profile — avoids null checks everywhere. Small change, low risk.
Mia: Timeline: Noah can push HubSpot workflow change today (low-risk), Sasha will update SF assignment logic tomorrow, Arjun will change enrichment output by EOD. Jules — can you confirm the fallback owner group id for mapping?
Jules: Confirmed group id: inbound-review-ops. Also we want a Slack ping to #sales-alerts when a lead goes into fallback. Adds visibility.
Mia: Perfect. Next: add an SLA metric to Redwood Console (marketing dashboard) to show % assigned within 30m, and a broken-out view for "enrichment delay" vs "round-robin issue".
Noah: I’ll add a dashboard tile after changes are live.
Sasha: Assigning tasks: Noah -> HubSpot workflow change; Arjun -> enrichment output fix; Sasha -> SF round-robin rule; Jules -> create fallback group + Slack webhook; Mia -> verification report and dashboard requirements.
Mia: Thanks all. Will follow up with a short playbook for sales on how to handle inbound-review queue (script + SLA expectations). :white_check_mark:
hubspot-bot: Workflows updated by Noah at 2026-03-21T11:08:00Z (change id wflow-88b2).
Noah: Done — pushed the 30m fallback rule and ownership_assigned_ts. Will monitor for any misfires.
Mia: Ran a quick check — new leads post-change are entering Inbound Review when enrichment stalled. Reporting looks healthier already.
Jules: Slack alerts working. 2 leads routed to inbound-review-ops in the last hour.
Arjun: Enrichment change deployed. We now send "n/a" for missing profiles.
Sasha: I’ll run a simulation tomorrow to validate round-robin skips OOO users.
Mia: Closing the thread — will post a short playbook and the verification dashboard link once Sasha confirms the SF test. Thanks! :tada:
